observation_collision.observable: The proposed acquired jet-to-target observation, if one is supplied.

constructive_transforms.proposed_object: At most one concrete public jet acquisition and quotient/action/frame candidate derived from actually read ingredients.

proof_search_map.quantifier_order: Freeze all candidate setup/query/advice dependencies and the selected signature specialization as a proposed amendment, not original intent. Preserve domain guards, common versus scalar-dependent good sets and complete-output semantics.

method_ceiling.strongest_certifiable_claim: A falsifiable construction proposal or no candidate among at most three considered routes; no theorem, existence, correctness, asymptotic improvement or lane exhaustion conclusion.

proof_obligations.claim: Actual candidate object and acquisition steps distinguish a construction proposal from blank type slots.

All acquisition/output/advice/success/memory costs and earliest falsifier are disclosed; no cost advantage inferred from a cheap forward map.

required_definition_slots: Actual raw jet and target quotient/action
lean_readiness.instructions: If a candidate is supplied, name its smallest exact missing lemma and required definitions as future work. No Lean source, axioms, proof or build. Formalization needs separately approved exact statement and dependencies.

controls: Unchanged representation or constant/zero output cannot count as acquired useful jet construction.
Hidden scalar labels, withheld masks, unpriced basis/advice or target-dependent factor-base selection reject claimed publicity.
A base-field tangent coefficient cannot become an N-action quotient by relabeling; actual bridge operation and obligations required.
Compare values only in an actual common frame or through specified transport; guard both source points and O/partial-domain handling.
No exchange of common versus scalar-dependent good-set quantifiers, or one-output versus every-output semantics.
Check exact P1547 hypotheses before using its scoped boundary; no new universal no-go or rederivation claimed.
Positive-looking ingredient must survive a proposed shape-matched null/known-false test; describe the test, do not run it.

joints.attack_plan: Read frozen interface boundaries and actual primary-source locators before accepting producer ingredient claims.
